pages.title: Reversi Evolved
pages.creator: Playful Cochon
pages.description:
Reversi Evolved is a board strategy game built on an eight-by-eight grid. Place a stone so it traps a line of opposing stones between the new piece and one of your existing pieces. Those trapped stones flip to your side, changing control of the board. Choose from the available legal squares and aim to finish with more stones than your opponent.

Click a square with the mouse or tap it on a touch screen. Consider both the pieces you can flip now and the moves your placement will leave for the other player.

pages.title: Animal Pair Card Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Animal Pair Card Match is a memory puzzle about uncovering matching animal pictures. Open two cards at a time and look for the same animal on both. Successful matches collect the target animals and help clear the board, while remembering earlier pictures makes it easier to choose the next pair. Helpful tools are available when a challenge becomes difficult. Use the mouse or touch controls to work through the animal card arrangements.

pages.title: Crazy Aunty : Slap & Punch
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description: Crazy Aunty : Slap & Punch is a cartoon action game about choosing a weapon or tool and landing a single hit. Tap to use the selected item against the main character and complete the level with a knockout. Progress unlocks more items with different effects and animations. Collect the level rewards and try the newly available tools as you continue through the stages.

pages.title: Mansion Story Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Mansion Story Match combines gem matching puzzles with a story set in a mysterious mansion. Make groups of at least three matching gems to remove them and work toward the current level's objective. Use boosters to help overcome obstacles on the board and collect rewards for completing puzzles. Progress takes you through hidden rooms, attics, and gardens as you uncover the mansion's secrets and find its treasures.

pages.title: Oreplication
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Oreplication is a factory building game about producing ore and increasing its value. Set up droppers and conveyors, then route the ore through upgraders and processing machines to turn production into in-game money. Each upgrader has rules and limits: some work only a certain number of times or below a stated ore value. Effects added by one machine can also make ore incompatible with another. Read the machine descriptions and experiment with the arrangement to create a production route whose parts work together.

pages.title: Zombie Monster Survivors
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Zombie Monster Survivors is a survival action game about fighting waves of zombies and monsters. Keep moving as enemies arrive, attack the crowd, and collect coins or energy during the struggle. Choose skills and use your resources to help with the threats you face. The focus is on sustaining the fight and making useful choices as more creatures close in on your survivor.

pages.title: Two Supra Drifters
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Two Supra Drifters is a drifting game with three tracks and a head-to-head challenge for two players. Take a Supra through the bends and compete with a friend to see who handles the drifting better. Player one uses WASD, while player two uses the arrow keys to drive, steer, and brake. Customize the car with body colors, underglow lighting, and rims before returning to the tracks.

pages.title: Addiction Solitaire
pages.creator: Catafractum
pages.description:
Addiction Solitaire asks you to arrange a full deck into four rows, each running from ace to king in the same suit. Move cards into empty spaces to build the sequences, choosing a card one rank above its left neighbor. Easy mode also lets you fill a space with a card one rank below the card on its right.

Choose between Easy and Hard and work out which moves will open useful spaces for the cards still out of order. You have up to three reshuffles per game to help rearrange a difficult position.

pages.title: HeroBall Adventures 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: HeroBall Adventures 2 is a platform game about rescuing friends taken away by a strange machine. Guide HeroBall through the levels, jump past obstacles, and work toward the end of each course while trying to save the missing characters. Collect points along the way and unlock new abilities as you progress. Use the keyboard or the on-screen buttons to take on the next stage of the rescue.

pages.title: Russian Fishing at Sea
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Russian Fishing at Sea lets you visit different waters and work on catching more than 100 kinds of fish. Hold and release the casting control to send out the rod, then watch for the hook icon that signals a bite. Manage the line's tension by pulling and releasing as you bring the fish closer or wear it down enough to land it.

Explore different fishing locations, use a range of gear, and complete the game's tasks. Aquariums add another activity, letting you grow fish and sell them as you continue developing your fishing collection.

pages.title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Heritage Mahjong Classic is a tile matching game built around one layout and three tile skins. Find identical tiles that are free on at least one side, then match them to remove them from the board. Keep opening up further matches as you work toward clearing the whole arrangement. Fast matches earn a time bonus, and the Hint feature can help when you need another possible pair.

pages.title: Mahjong Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: Infinity Loop
pages.description: Mahjong Slide Puzzle asks you to move tiles into clear horizontal or vertical matches. Tap or slide to rearrange the tiles, bringing the same patterns into line without another tile obstructing them. Keep looking for moves that create a usable match and open more of the board. Clear the arrangement to complete the level and work toward higher scores across the puzzle challenges.

pages.title: Fidget Trading Card Toy
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Fidget Trading Card Toy is a card collecting game built around flipping cards against an opponent. Take part in card battles and use the slap action during the trading duel as you try to add rare cards to your collection. More collected cards give you more options for later trades. Click or tap to play through the duels and work on expanding your toy card collection.

pages.title: Stumble Guys
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stumble Guys is an elimination adventure about getting through obstacle courses ahead of the other competitors. Run, sprint, and slide past the opposition while reacting to obstacles along the route. Different levels challenge your movement and memory as you try to stay in the contest. Use the mouse or touch controls to work through the rounds and aim to survive until the end.

pages.title: Merge Drop
pages.creator: batpad
pages.description: Merge Drop combines buying and merging balls with a block breaking drop. Prepare your balls, then release them into the cubes in their path. Contact with a cube multiplies the balls as they break through the obstacles. Your goal is to get balls to the end of the level. Work on your collection and choose how to send it through the arrangement to complete the stage.

pages.title: Domino Smash 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Domino Smash 3D is a physics puzzle about sending a ball into a domino arrangement. Guide the ball past obstacles and hit the dominoes so the whole set falls down. Consider where the first impact will start the chain before making your move. Complete different levels to unlock more domino challenges, using the mouse or touch controls to play.

pages.title: TicToc Braided Hairstyles
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: TicToc Braided Hairstyles is a hair styling game featuring Regina and Kiki. Follow hairstylist Brian as you work on braided looks for the two characters, then customize the finished hairstyles. Once the hair is ready, choose clothes to complete each girl's outfit. Use the mouse or touch controls to explore the styling choices and put together a look that combines the braids with her clothes.

pages.title: Love Cats Rope
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Love Cats Rope is a drawing puzzle about bringing two woolen cats together. Hold and drag with the mouse or a finger to draw a line that helps the cats roll toward each other. Think about the shape you need before drawing so it guides their movement into a meeting. The game also lets you change the thread color, dress the cats, and choose a different background.

pages.title: Bus Parking Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Bus Parking Simulator 3D puts you in control of a bus maneuvering into difficult parking areas. Steer through parking lots, narrow streets, and obstacle filled spaces, paying attention to the room needed for each turn. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space for the handbrake. V changes the camera angle, while Tab pauses. Line up the bus carefully as you approach the parking position.

pages.title: Super Defense Tank
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Super Defense Tank is an arcade tank shooter about fighting enemies with a growing set of cannons and power-ups. Collect equipment, keep firing, and take on four Robot Kings as you work toward better scores. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, shoot with J or Z, and switch with K or X. Esc or Enter pauses the action. Combine movement with sustained shooting to handle the threats ahead.

pages.title: Words in Ladder
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Words in Ladder gives you two minutes to make as many words as you can from a starting word. Change it by adding a letter, removing one, swapping a letter, or rearranging the letters into an anagram. Drag between the letters with the mouse or a finger to select your answer. Keep considering different kinds of changes so you can find more valid words before the timer ends.

pages.title: Underwater World
pages.creator: icup
pages.description: Underwater World is a mahjong style puzzle about collecting matching stones in groups of three. Find the same designs and select three at a time to remove them from the playing field. Clear every stone to complete the level and continue through different board arrangements. Weekly and themed challenges offer stars to earn as you work through more of the matching puzzles.

pages.title: Be The Judge
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Be The Judge is a choice based game in which you decide who is right and who is guilty in fictional incidents around a town. Consider the situation presented and use the mouse to select your decision. Each case puts another judgment in front of you, asking you to weigh what happened before choosing how to respond.

pages.title: Jungle Bubble Shooter Mania
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jungle Bubble Shooter Mania is a bubble matching game set in a jungle. Aim your shots to join groups of at least three bubbles and pop them from the arrangement. Look for a place where the current bubble can help clear a matching group, then prepare another shot. Boosters and power-ups give you additional help as you work through the bubble challenges.

pages.title: Tiny Landlord
pages.creator: PlayCade Interactive GmbH
pages.description: Tiny Landlord is a city management game about using cash flow to expand and improve a town. Decide where to spend the available money as you develop the city and add more facilities. Trees, streetlights, and other additions help make the streets more appealing to residents. Use the mouse to manage the upgrades and balance further expansion with improvements to the city you already have.

pages.title: Who is This
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Who is This is a fictional chat puzzle about identifying the stranger you are talking to. Choose questions and responses to gather clues, then use what you learn to work out who is behind the conversation. Some chats ask you to complete drawing tasks or math puzzles along the way. Use the mouse to select decisions and keep following the clues until you can identify the stranger.

pages.title: Room Escape 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Room Escape 3D is a prison escape puzzle about getting past guards without being discovered. Look for a way through the rooms, avoid the enemies, and work through the action tasks and puzzles that block your escape. Consider a safer route before moving into an exposed position. Use the mouse or touch controls to make your way through the guarded areas.

pages.title: BFFs Trendy Squad Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFFs Trendy Squad Fashion is a styling game about preparing Barbie and her friends for a Squad Fashion event. Help the group choose their looks and compare the clothing choices as you get each character ready. Try coordinating the outfits while giving the friends different styles. Use the left mouse button to select the fashion items and complete the group's preparations.

pages.title: Platform Jumper
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Platform Jumper is an endless climbing game about jumping higher and earning more points. Move between the platforms and keep working upward, watching where you can land next as the ascent continues. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the jumps and try to reach a greater height. Each attempt gives you another chance to improve your score.

pages.title: Helix Stack Ball
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Helix Stack Ball is a descent challenge set around a spiral tower. Guide the ball all the way to the bottom while avoiding the wrong objects along the route. Use the mouse controls and choose your actions carefully as you work past the tower's sections. Keep watching the path below the ball and aim to reach the base without making a wrong move.

pages.title: Time Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description:
Time Shooter is an action game in which movement controls the pace of the world. Stand still to slow the action and examine the bullets and enemies around you, then move to let time advance again. Plan a route through the incoming shots and eliminate the enemies while avoiding damage.

Use WASD to move. The left mouse button shoots or throws a weapon, while the right mouse button picks one up. Pause your movement when you need to assess the next threat, then commit to an attack or a safer position.

pages.title: Trivia! Best family quiz
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Trivia! Best family quiz is a general knowledge game with 1,800 questions. Read a question and choose an answer from four options. A wrong choice lets you try another answer, so you can keep working out the solution. Once you find the right response, a humorous information popup explains more about the topic. Continue through the questions and see which areas of general knowledge you recognize.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Helping Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Helping Time follows Hazel as she helps her family with everyday chores. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the other characters, responding to their needs as you complete the household activities. Pay attention to what each task requires and help her finish the work. Guide Hazel through the different jobs as she spends the day lending her family a hand.

pages.title: Get On Top Touch
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Get On Top Touch is a two-player contest between interconnected characters. You control one hero and a friend controls the other, with each trying to maneuver into the position on top. Use movement and jumps to shift the balance instead of moving at random. Watch how the two characters affect each other's position and choose when to push for the advantage. The game supports computer and touch controls.

pages.title: Duck Hunter
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Duck Hunter is an arcade hunting game about shooting ducks before they leave the screen. Move the sight with WASD or the arrow keys and press Space to fire, lining up each duck before it flies away. A dog accompanies the hunt as you work on hitting more targets. Watch the ducks' movement and adjust the sight quickly enough to get another shot.

pages.title: Eat Small Fishes
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Eat Small Fishes puts you in control of a fish searching for smaller prey. Tap to move through the water and eat the small fish to build your score. Stay away from larger fish, because colliding with one ends the game. Keep choosing openings that let you reach another small fish without moving into the path of a bigger one.

pages.title: Super Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Super Girl Dress Up is a fashion game about creating a superhero look for Barbie. Choose a new outfit for the superpowered character and compare the clothing options as you put her style together. Try different combinations to find the look you want her to wear. Use the mouse or touch controls to make the selections and finish the superhero outfit.

pages.title: Range Rover Cars Parking
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Range Rover Cars Parking is a driving game about positioning a Range Rover in a parking space. Use WASD or the arrow keys to maneuver the vehicle and press Space to brake. Judge the approach to the parking position, making controlled turns as you line up the car. Work on accurate steering and stopping as you complete the parking task.

pages.title: Mr Bullet 2 Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mr Bullet 2 Online puts you in the role of a lone spy fighting villains across different areas. Choose a hero, collect a weapon, and start working through the enemies in each encounter. Use the mouse or touch controls to take aim and attack as you continue the adventure. Keep focusing on the remaining villains and clear the opposition from the area.

pages.title: Quarantine Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Quarantine Rush is a game about managing a fictional outbreak. Send people home and use power-ups to cure infected characters within the game. Collect coins as you help the population, then unlock more items to assist with further rescues. Use the mouse or touch controls to respond to the people who need attention and keep working through the outbreak.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunt Madness
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Monster Truck Stunt Madness is a driving game with 75 stunt levels across six environments. Take a 4x4 monster truck onto courses filled with raised platforms, large jumps, and destructible props. Jump between the structures and keep driving after each landing as you work toward completing the course quickly. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the truck and adjust your approach to the next stunt.

pages.title: Pixelcraft Hidden Diamond Blocks
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pixelcraft Hidden Diamond Blocks challenges you to find ten hidden diamond blocks in each of six scenes. Search the pictures carefully and click or tap the blocks you spot before the countdown expires. Repeated clicks in the wrong places remove an extra five seconds, so random guessing can make the search harder. Find the full set in the current picture and continue through the remaining levels.

pages.title: Farming Town
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Farming Town is an open-world farming simulator about working the land with agricultural machines. Plow fields, sow crops, and bring in the harvest, then sell what you have grown to earn money for more equipment. New tractors and combines give you more machines to use as you develop the farm. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the vehicles and progress through the career.

pages.title: War Tanks Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Search tank pictures for concealed stars in War Tanks Hidden Stars. There are six levels, each with ten stars to locate before time runs out. Use the mouse or touch controls to select the stars you find, checking the details in the vehicles and their surroundings. Repeated wrong selections cost five seconds, so keep your search deliberate and uncover the whole set before the clock expires.

pages.title: Bingo 75
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Bingo 75 is a number marking game based on a draw of 75 numbers. Select how many cards you want to play, choose the game's betting options, and follow the numbers as they are called. Mark the matching numbers on your cards and watch for a winning combination. Keep checking each card as the draw progresses and see whether it reaches a win.

pages.title: Sky Burger
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Sky Burger is a catching game about collecting falling ingredients to complete a burger level. Move the base left and right with the mouse so it catches the ingredients you need. Each stage has target amounts for different ingredients, so keep track of what is still required as the food falls. Meet the current collection goals to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Track Driving Game 2020
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Impossible Truck Track Driving Game 2020 challenges you to complete truck missions on difficult tracks. Drive with the arrow keys, using Up to accelerate, Down to brake, and Left or Right to steer. Careful positioning matters because a wrong move can end the attempt. Watch the route ahead and manage your speed as you work through each driving mission.

pages.title: Airplane Free Fly Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Airplane Free Fly Simulator is a 3D flying game about completing flights and ground tasks. Take off, steer toward the destination, deliver passengers on time, and taxi to the marked airplane parking area. Use S for takeoff and W for landing, with A and D to turn. F controls the throttle and Space reduces it. Work through the flight objectives and bring the aircraft into position to complete the current task.

pages.title: Fireman Rescue
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Fireman Rescue is a reaction game about catching people who jump from a burning building. Guide the firefighters' rescue sheet beneath the falling characters and keep reacting to the next person who needs help. Tap the screen to change the team's direction, choosing when to turn so the sheet reaches the right position. Rescue as many people as you can.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Blocks Collapse
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas 2019 Blocks Collapse is a matching puzzle about clearing connected holiday blocks. Select a group of at least two similar blocks to collapse it and earn points. Larger connections award more points, and a group of six or more also gives you a bomb. Look over the arrangement for useful clusters before choosing which blocks to clear next.

pages.title: Balls Fill 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Balls Fill 3D is a setup puzzle about guiding balls into a bottle. Tap the obstacles to rotate them into positions that will direct the falling balls toward the container. When the arrangement is ready, press the Ready button, then tap to pour out the balls. Consider the route through the obstacles before starting the pour and try to send the balls successfully into the bottle.

pages.title: Tropical Paradise Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Tropical Paradise Difference challenges you to find seven changes between two pictures in each level. There are ten levels, with one minute available to finish each scene. Use the mouse or touch controls to select the differences you notice, checking both the large objects and the smaller details. Find all seven before the timer expires and continue through the tropical picture challenges.

pages.title: Nummzle!
pages.creator: Lightning Strike Games
pages.description: Nummzle! is a route planning puzzle about coloring every numbered square. Begin at the colored boxes and follow numbers that increase along your route. The values do not have to be consecutive, so consider more than just the next number when planning a path. Try different routes and work out how to cover the remaining numbers until the whole puzzle is painted.

pages.title: Truck Loads Simulator 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Truck Loads Simulator 3D puts you in the role of a cargo truck driver. Take control of a loaded vehicle and work through the freight transport tasks, concentrating on moving the truck and its cargo along the route. Manage the vehicle's size as you steer it toward the delivery destination.

pages.title: Offroad Car Race
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Offroad Car Race is a driving game about competing against other cars and meeting the current stage's finishing requirement. Some levels ask you to complete the race, while others require a place near the front of the field. Follow the route and work on your position as you take on each objective. Use WASD to drive, C to change the camera, and Esc to pause.

pages.title: Slime Rush TD 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Slime Rush TD 2 is a tower defense game about stopping another invasion of slime monsters before they reach the kingdom's gate. Set up armed towers and use their coverage to hold back the advancing horde. The sequel brings new towers into the defense, giving you more options for protecting the approach. Plan where your defenses will be most useful and keep the slimes away from the kingdom.

pages.title: Miner Rusher 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Miner Rusher 2 is an endless platform adventure about keeping a miner on a safe route. Run and jump past spikes and monsters, switch paths to reach new sections, and avoid falling off the platforms. Pick up boxes and collect coins along the way. Coins can buy new skins in the shop as you work on surviving longer and building a higher score. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the run.

pages.title: Inferno. Monster ball hell run
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Inferno. Monster ball hell run is a dark platform adventure about guiding a monster ball through the underworld. Make your way past chainsaws, demons, and other hazards as you work through the levels on a journey out of Hell. Choose your movement carefully around the dangers and continue toward the next area. The game combines the ball's movement through obstacle courses with encounters across its infernal setting.

pages.title: Yatzy Yahtzee Yams Classic Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Yatzy Yahtzee Yams Classic Edition is a dice game about building the strongest score from your rolls. Choose which dice to keep and reroll the others as you look for a useful combination. Record a result in an available scorecard category, then plan around the entries still open. Each selection affects what remains possible later, so balance the current roll against the combinations you still want to complete.

pages.title: Office Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Office Fashion is a dress-up game about creating work outfits for different office jobs. Choose clothes and accessories for the characters, comparing the fashion items to find combinations suited to each role. Put together a complete office look and experiment with other pairings for the next character. The focus is on coordinating everyday work clothes with the finishing accessories.

pages.title: Space Purge
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Space Purge is an arcade space defense game about stopping asteroids from destroying Earth. Guide a spaceship through the attack and shoot the incoming threats before they reach the planet. Keep track of both the ship and Earth's condition as you continue the defense. Clear asteroids, build your score, and keep the planet protected while more hazards arrive.

pages.title: Swing Jetpack Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Swing Jetpack Game is a survival flying game controlled by tapping the screen. Tap to flip the jetpack hero and adjust the flight as obstacles approach. Judge the timing of each flip so the hero stays clear of the barriers and keeps moving through the course. Try to extend the attempt and survive longer with more carefully timed changes.

pages.title: Tank Wars
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Tank Wars is an arcade tank battle game about destroying enemy armor while protecting your base. Fight alone or with a friend across the battlefields, balancing attacks on enemy vehicles with keeping the base secure. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to fire, or play with the touch controls. Keep watching the threats near the base as you take on the opposing tanks.

pages.title: Knife Hit
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Knife Hit is a timing game about throwing knives into wooden targets. Choose when to launch each blade and keep the throws on target as you work toward the boss encounters. Fast boss targets change the timing needed, so watch their movement before committing to the next throw.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Snowy Scenes
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Snowy Scenes is a winter themed picture puzzle. Fit the separate pieces together to rebuild the snowy scene, comparing the shapes and picture details to work out where each part belongs. Keep joining the remaining pieces until the full winter image is restored.

pages.title: Kitty Care and Grooming
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Kitty Care and Grooming is a pet care game about helping a little cat after she has been lost. Work through the care activities to get the kitten back on her feet, then give her a relaxing bath. Choose clothing and cute accessories to finish the grooming session. Help the cat through the different stages of care and put together a new look for her.

pages.title: Pinball of Oz
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Pinball of Oz combines pinball action with Dorothy's adventures in the land of Oz. Send balls through the boards, hit pegs and other targets, and work toward the current mission's goals. Use the flippers where they are available to keep a ball moving and reach more targets. Rainbow magic and Oz themed encounters shape the stages as you continue the adventure. Play with the mouse or keyboard.

pages.title: Farm Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Farm Mahjong is a tile matching puzzle with a farm theme. Look through the arrangement for pairs showing the same picture, then select them to remove the tiles. Keep finding more matches as the board changes and work toward clearing the whole field. Follow the farm themed designs across the puzzle and check the remaining tiles for another pair.

pages.title: Whack the Tablet
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Whack the Tablet is a virtual destruction game about attacking an Apple or Android style tablet. Choose a tool such as a hammer, baseball bat, or gun and use it against the device. Try the different tools as you work on smashing the virtual tablet and see the effects of each attack.

pages.title: Ellie VS Annie Christman Tree!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate two holiday trees in Ellie VS Annie Christman Tree! Help Ellie and Annie each prepare a Christmas tree by choosing the decorations for their separate designs. Try different combinations as you work on each tree, then compare the results and decide which one you prefer for Christmas night. The game focuses on styling both trees for the girls' celebration.
